experiment: Transfer the frozen P25 entry dates, pair selection, direction, profitability gates and monthly sizing decisions to ATM calls and P75 puts
contract_mapping: Keep each wing's original selected contracts. Use cached alternative choices only on missing dates and only with signal OI>=100. Leave missing IDs in the replay for explicit execution rejection.

unchanged_execution.holding: Each leg to its own expiry with the existing audited corporate exits
unchanged_execution.risk: Original shared inventory, funding and per-pair/per-wing risk budgets

interpretation: Preserving the working P25 decision stream restores the approximately 0.8 P25 result exactly and gives a stronger combined result than the previous common wing-native gate reconstruction. The P25 sizing decisions do not add Sharpe in the other wings or combined book. This experiment establishes decision transfer; it does not establish equal economic signal across the smile or successful independently trained wing sizing.
limits: Cached fallback is not an exhaustive search for every usable OI100 expiry
P75 has explicit missing contracts on 385 proposals
Transferred model outputs use P25 states; no wing-native sizing model was fitted in this experiment
Previously inspected history, retrospective formation-calendar conditioning and no fresh holdout
Combined inventory can change P25 executions even though its proposals and standalone baseline are preserved
